snippet.title: Suncraft | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Suncraft on Steam today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078110/Suncraft

Another sun-filled day begins in this cozy pixel-art adventure. Gather resources, craft items, and upgrade tools to expand the land. Can you rebuild the grand Lighthouse and bring the village back to its golden days?
